decisionBox.changed: Levels unchanged. What changed operationally: added another small 15 USDT tranche to the spot core on this pullback toward the 84,339-84,483 support shelf -- a better entry than this morning's add near the highs. Fresh OKX liquidations this run flipped hard to long-side (~$852.4k vs ~$515.7 short, versus ~$207k short-heavy at morning), clustered 84,300-84,475 -- consistent with longs getting flushed on the reversal from the new high. 4H MACD histogram flipped back negative (-1.66, from +7.13 at morning) and 1H/15m RSI cooled sharply (67.64->48.18 and 59.51->42.14), but price held above the established support band and above all 4H/daily EMAs, so this reads as a within-range flush rather than a trend change.
